selected_evidence.requirement: /srv/drop is shared writable and prevents cross-user deletion
selected_evidence.summary: Mode is 1777 (drwxrwxrwt); two non-root identities wrote successfully, own-file deletion succeeded, and cross-user deletion failed with Operation not permitted.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 984a7d52-3387-4830-a06e-15e8b5e6c2a1, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 202fa7f7-2243-4342-8fea-a991898ab617, running system state, persisted data, mode 1777, shared writes, and sticky-bit protection after restart.

commands.command:
set -eu
rm -f /srv/drop/daemon-owned /srv/drop/nobody-owned
runuser -u daemon -- sh -c 'printf daemon > /srv/drop/daemon-owned'
runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'printf nobody > /srv/drop/nobody-owned'
printf '%s\n' 'created-by-two-users:'
stat -c '%n owner=%U uid=%u mode=%a' /srv/drop/daemon-owned /srv/drop/nobody-owned
if runuser -u nobody -- rm /srv/drop/daemon-owned 2>/tmp/drop-denied.err; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: cross-user deletion unexpectedly succeeded'
  exit 1
else
  printf 'cross-user-delete=blocked message='
  tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/drop-denied.err
  printf '\n'
fi
runuser -u nobody -- rm /srv/drop/nobody-owned
printf 'own-delete=allowed remaining-daemon-file='
if [ -f /srv/drop/daemon-owned ]; then printf 'yes\n'; else printf 'no\n'; exit 1; fi
rm -f /srv/drop/daemon-owned /tmp/drop-denied.err
commands.stdout:

/srv/drop/daemon-owned owner=daemon uid=2 mode=644
/srv/drop/nobody-owned owner=nobody uid=65534 mode=644
cross-user-delete=blocked message=rm: cannot remove '/srv/drop/daemon-owned': Operation not permitted 
own-delete=allowed remaining-daemon-file=yes
